name: together-chat
note: EYEDROPPED from refs/together-chat.mp4, not invented. This is a RECREATION theme: the reference film's own palette, sampled off its real frames so the recreation can be compared against it pixel for pixel. Accent #066bfe is the send button and the one blue word, measured at 6.9s and 16.5s; the ground is #fdfdfd, a near-pure white that is NOT #ffffff and reads warmer than our own; ink is #171c25, sampled from the input bar's own type. It exists to benchmark the engine against a real film. It is not a vawe brand theme.
